title: Kino Loy
subtitle: Independent
description: After years inside, Kino Loy had effectively adapted to life at the Imperial prison facility on Narkina 5. As floor manager, he demanded efficiency from his crew as they toiled to meet the rigurous daily production quotas mandated by their Imperial overlords. After the workday closed, Loy would naively dream of the day he would be granted his freedom.
